items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: A young man named Alesch was also a guest of Felix and he did such things as making trumpets out of cardboard... That was an idea of Alesch and it was beautiful to see all those different coloured balloons going up to the blue sky

ctx.x: This happened at the country home of Felix Debrit, in Lugnorre. Felix was the fellow that assisted me in getting to play in Switzerland in 1949-1950. Many of my Swiss musician friends were invited as well as my very good friend Johnny Simmen and his wife, daughter and many more people that I knew and quite a few that I had never met before.

A young man named Alesch was also a guest of Felix and he did such things as making trumpets out of cardboard, putting them on long sticks and placing them where the road turn off and on to the lane which went tothe house of Felix, $o that people coming to the party could find the house easily. He also had balloons blown up that came to the number of 68 - years that corresponded my age, and which I sent up to the sky at a certain time. Each balloon had a ticket on it with my address and a statement that I would…

There were quite a number of Swiss jazz musicians that came to the party which got off to an early start that afternoon and finished in the wee hours the next morning. An American bass player named Bob Carter came all the way from where he lived, somewhere in Germany, near Munich. I had worked with Bob a few days in Mulhouse, France. There were at least 8 trumpet players. A few were only amateurs and I had worked with some of them. There was even a violinist and many other instruments. Lily had prepared a lot of…
